name: Thiên Mệnh

categories.label: Victory Points (final)
categories.hint: Total Victory Points gained from buildings; 50 VP wins instantly. Only players still in the game compete.

categories.label: Winner
categories.hint: Last player standing, or 50 VP, or highest VP among surviving players when the deck runs out

winCondition: Win by (a) being the only player left (others eliminated by losing all Supply/health), (b) reaching 50 Victory Points, or (c) when the draw deck runs out and everyone has played the final round: highest Victory Points among players still in the game. Playing the Thien-Menh card reshuffles discard and draw deck, postponing (c).

endCondition.description: First to 50 VP, last player standing, or deck-out with highest VP

notes: family: race-to-goal. Official rulebook not retrievable (BGG file download needs login); modelled from the BGG game description only. Tiebreaker for deck-out ties, starting Supply value and elimination details unverified.
